candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to betLimit plus the provided amount (so AdjustBetAmounts increases betLimit instead of setting it).
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to amount divided by two (so AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit to half the provided amount).
Replace owner check with a different sender check (require msg.sender == whale) so only the whale can call functions guarded by onlyOwner, affecting who can change betLimit.
Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment that clamps amount to a maximum of 1 ether (using a conditional), so AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit to min(amount, 1 ether).
Change AdjustDifficulty to add a require that only allows difficulty to be increased (prevents lowering), altering the resulting difficulty value after calls.
Change AdjustDifficulty to update difficulty after emitting the event (emit shows old value, then state changes), making the observed event value differ from final state.
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow calls from any address (remove owner check), so AdjustDifficulty can be called by others changing observed difficulty.
Change OpenToThePublic to set openToPublic = false instead of true (inverts effect).
Modify onlyOwner modifier to compare against whale instead of owner, so only whale can call OpenToThePublic.
Remove the onlyOwner guard from OpenToThePublic so anyone can call it (making openToPublic set true by any caller).
Change OpenToThePublic to toggle openToPublic instead of setting it to true.
Replace betLimit assignment to set betLimit to amount + 1 (off-by-one change) so AdjustBetAmounts results differ.
Assign betLimit to half the provided amount (divide by 2), changing observable betLimit after the call.
Remove the assignment to betLimit and only emit the event (so betLimit remains unchanged after call).
Make onlyOwner modifier allow any caller by removing the require check, so AdjustBetAmounts becomes callable by anyone (changing observable outcome for calls by non-owners).
